assumptions.statement: Detailed regulatory controls, road redlines, ownership, municipal utilities, and engineering constraints must be confirmed from official attachments before statutory use.
assumptions.impact: The package can be reviewed as a formal AI submission only for provided official boundaries and submitted design layers; statutory controls still need professional confirmation.

assumptions.statement: SEB v0.5.0 (Service Equivalence Baseline, CC BY-SA 4.0, upstream issue #2549) is adopted as the criteria skeleton for AI-off usability; localized spec/fixtures/validator shipped under visual/assets/. Adoption means criteria alignment only - no slot is rated, operational, approved or government-committed.
assumptions.impact: Reviewers can reproduce the localized criteria check offline (node visual/assets/seb-localized-tabletop-run.js); all SEB performance metrics stay unknown until real operation and registered recalculation paths are followed.

assumptions.statement: The eight pilot-readiness fields are adopted as a self-imposed checklist only. No baseline exists in this package; every unknown cell is frozen with a named owner and a recomputation path instead of being filled with an estimated number.
assumptions.impact: If a baseline is later supplied by the district, the operator or a field survey, the frozen cells must be rewritten and the ledger counts and metrics recomputed before any pilot claim is made.

assumptions.statement: Responsible parties named in the ledger (sub-district offices, park operators, data-compliance and legal bodies) are placeholders derived from public reporting and from the proposal's own role assignment; none has confirmed acceptance of the duty.
assumptions.impact: Any operational claim depends on written confirmation from the named parties; until then the ledger supports review, not implementation.

assumptions.statement: 街道剖面规范研究图(street-section-norms.png)中的建筑高度 H=24 m 取自包内 geometry 占位值(104 面全部 24 m / 6 层、无高差),道路图层不含任何宽度字段且 confidence=low;因此该图是按采纳的 D/H 标准反推的规范剖面,不是现状实测断面。正式控规限高与实测断面到位后必须重绘,在此之前不得称其为实测。
assumptions.impact: 限制剖面图与人视点判断的证据强度:可用于设计标准推演与方案自洽检验,不可用于声称现状空间尺度已被测量证实。

assumptions.statement: 总体范围 SITE-001 与三处重点区域 PROV-KEY-001/002/003 均为仓库登记的 provisional 边界,却是 site_area_sqm(1141.28 公顷)与 key_area_zhongzhiyuan_ha / key_area_origin_community_ha / key_area_dazhongsi_ha(192.0 / 103.8 / 71.7 公顷)等 known 指标的唯一数值基础。此处 known 的含义是「由包内几何可复算」,不是「与官方红线一致」。
assumptions.impact: 官方 polygon 到位后,site_area_sqm、三项 key_area 面积、land_use 分类面积、green_ratio、public_space_ratio 与全部图件必须全量重算;在此之前不得把这些面积读作实测值或审批依据,也不得据此计算容积率等衍生控制指标。

assumptions.statement: PROV-KEY-002(北京 AI 原点社区,103.8 公顷)是按公告约值 104.3 公顷绘制的 provisional 矩形,与真实运营中的原点社区实际 footprint 尚未锚定对齐,存在位置与形状偏差;当前仅能声明面积量级一致(偏差 0.5%),不能声明空间范围一致。
assumptions.impact: 涉及原点社区的场景卡(P02/P04/P07/P09/P12)与用户画像落位,在官方或运营方边界到位前只作为设计假设使用;不得把原点社区的运营事实(企业数、人才数、楼宇名)与本包 provisional 矩形合并叙述为已核实的空间结论。
